name: create-api-key
description: Create a new API key in Resend. The token is only shown once upon creation, so you MUST display it to the user.

permission.description: Access level. "full_access" grants complete resource management. "sending_access" restricts to email delivery only.

domainId.description: Restrict API key to send emails from a specific domain. Only applicable when permission is "sending_access".
